records.text: Frank Turek said he was FaceTiming his son and daughter-in-law during the event and left the call running in his pocket from the shooting until he reached his hotel.
records.speaker: Frank Turek

appearances.snippet: Well, it was my son and daughter-in-law. I mean, he is 35 years old. I was FaceTiming them because they love Charlie (Charlie Kirk). First, I was FaceTiming my wife, and then I said, “Let me call Spencer (Frank Turek’s son; surname unverified),” so I started FaceTiming him. ... During the event, yeah—both during the event and then when the shot rang out, I just started heading toward the car. I put the phone in my back pocket; I did not turn it off. Instinctively, by the time I got to a hotel and pulled it out, they were still there.

verification.notes: The embedded Megyn Kelly interview directly records Turek saying he was FaceTiming his adult son and daughter-in-law, put the phone in his back pocket after the shot, and found them still connected when he reached a hotel. Turek later said he misspoke and meant hospital, but the statement accurately reports what he said in the quoted interview.

links.title: Phone Inconsistency Is Not Plot Proof

records.text: Owens accused Frank Turek of repeatedly changing his account of the FaceTime call and suggested that his live-stream explanation might be a limited hangout.
records.speaker: Candace Owens

appearances.snippet: Something's not right about Frank Turek's story as well. And he's changed it. He keeps getting caught, and then, 'Oh, I misspoke, and this—I didn't mean that,' and, 'Oh, people are taking me out of context. I said I was on the FaceTime call forever, and now I say I'm not.' It's me versus me. Frank Turek is messy. He is messy. And so I do wonder, while he was live streaming and accidentally left it in the pocket, if that's like a limited hangout. He's telling us a little bit there.

verification.notes: Transcript context reviewed. Frank Turek later acknowledged that he had misspoken once about where Charlie Kirk's FaceTime call ended, attributing the discrepancy to trauma and age. That supports a location inconsistency, but current public evidence does not establish repeated deliberate changes or the accusation that his later account was a 'limited hangout.'

sources.title: Frank Turek Responds to Candace Owens' Claims
sources.relevance: Turek acknowledges one location-related misspeaking and gives his explanation; the source does not substantiate deliberate repeated changes or a 'limited hangout.'
